name: Every operator console page and API returns 404 on the custom domains, for reads and writes alike
The same paths pass through unchanged on the exact allowed hosts (the deployment's own hosts and the listed alias), where the existing console behaviour applies
Public and customer paths on the custom domain are not affected
No suffix is trusted: an unrelated *.vercel.app host, look-alikes, a local host on Vercel and an empty host are refused
Fail-closed configuration: deployment hosts can be withdrawn, a custom domain in VERCEL_URL is never trusted, and with nothing allowed the console answers nowhere on Vercel
detail: withdrawn false; custom domain via VERCEL_URL false; anything allowed with no configuration false

name: The middleware matcher covers every admin surface the gate names
Every route that resolves its actor with getAdminSession() sits under a gated path
